data.body: Proceeding with Track A fix per cluster RESULT. Implementation plan: (1) add _TEST_BRANCH_TAG=$$-${RANDOM} + per-test counter so each of T1-T11 has a unique BRANCH; (2) make T7 prepopulation writer atomic via .tmp+mv; (3) rm -f state file at end of every test as belt-and-suspenders; (4) verify with stress-run before commit.
